entities.name: Kenneth Wendell Ravenell
entities.context: Sentenced to 57 months in federal prison for money laundering conspiracy

entities.name: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Maryland
U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia

red_flags.flag: used bank accounts of the law firm to launder more than a million dollars
red_flags.red_flag: Professional gatekeeper misuse: Law firm accounts used for laundering
red_flags.category: professional-gatekeeper misuse (attorneys, trust accounts, corporate service providers)

red_flags.flag: used the law firm’s bank accounts to receive drug payments and make payments to attorneys retained to represent other members of the conspiracy
red_flags.red_flag: Commingling illicit funds with legitimate legal fees and operational expenses

red_flags.flag: concealing and misrepresenting the source of the funds and promoting the client’s unlawful activity
red_flags.red_flag: Concealment and detection-evasion: Misrepresenting source of funds to promote illegal activity
red_flags.category: concealment & detection-evasion (encrypted comms, fake identities, record destruction, timing)

red_flags.flag: advised the drug dealer to set up businesses that generated cash themselves and make investments in real estate projects
red_flags.red_flag: Structuring/threshold-avoidance: Advising on layering via cash-generating businesses and real estate

red_flags.flag: mixing cash generated by marijuana sales with cash generated by ticket sales
red_flags.red_flag: Commingling illicit cash with legitimate business revenue (entertainment events)

red_flags.flag: personally laundered his client’s drug proceeds using the firm’s attorney trust account
red_flags.red_flag: Professional gatekeeper misuse: Attorney trust account used for laundering
red_flags.category: professional-gatekeeper misuse (attorneys, trust accounts, corporate service providers)

red_flags.flag: accepted more than $1.8 million in drug proceeds and funds co-mingled with drug proceeds
red_flags.red_flag: Bulk cash placement: Accepting large sums of commingled illicit funds

red_flags.flag: instructed the associate to convert the drug proceeds into money orders and other instruments to conceal the source of the funds
red_flags.red_flag: Structuring/threshold-avoidance: Converting cash to monetary instruments to obscure trail

red_flags.flag: client learned that Ravenell had only credited $187,000 to his case, not the more than $350,000 that the client had paid
red_flags.red_flag: Institutional control failure: Misappropriation of client funds and lack of transparency
red_flags.category: institutional control failure (willful blindness, monitoring gaps, paper-only compliance, profit-over-compliance)
